The gap to the two-book consensus is moderate rather than extreme. No material blocker is identified, although role and settlement are unverified and correlation with Jenner applies.","model_case":"The projected mean of about 0.72 points and median of one support an over 0.5 at ordinary second-six usage near 16 minutes. The weakness is that line and power-play assignment are unverified. A demotion would cut the points rate, and the separately shrunk production rate is doing much of the work.","price_case":"This is the main 0.5 line at +140, so break-even is about +140 implied. The model's fair price is near -104, and its minimum acceptable price is +115. Consensus across two other books prices the over shorter than the model but longer than its fair price. Two books is thin coverage.","context_case":"The injury table lists Tampa Bay center absences, which could weaken the opposing lineup if they hold. It is a live snapshot of unknown timing and does not confirm Dubois's status. Vasilevskiy is the projected starter, not a confirmed one.","blocking_checks":[]},"countercase":"Points props carry high variance. If Dubois skates third-line minutes without power-play time, the rate the model relies on may be overstated. The market's longer price may reflect role information the model lacks. Vasilevskiy in net would suppress scoring. This shares a game with the Jenner shots over, so outcomes are correlated rather than independent confirmations.","open_checks":["Confirm Dubois's line and power-play unit at morning skate or warmups.","Check whether Brayden Point returns, since his listed timeline reaches game day.","Confirm the Tampa Bay starting goalie.","Verify BetMGM settlement rules and reconfirm that +140 is still available."],"evidence":[{"source_id":"821f30fe677aa56e292c","excerpt":"Brayden Point (C); Undisclosed; IR. Expected to be out until at least Nov 17","interpretation":"If Point remains out, Tampa Bay's center depth is thinner, which could modestly ease the matchup. The listed date coincides with game day, so his return is possible and should not be assumed either way.","kind":"injury","direction":"context","represented_in":"unknown"}]},{"candidate_id":"21b6b4cf7c1abe31991f9400","status":"needs_information","assessment":{"verdict":"consider","reason":"The projected mean near 1.9 shots against a 1.5 line and a median of two support the over at +110. The full sensitivity range stays above break-even, and no material blocker is identified. Role and settlement remain unverified.","model_case":"Projected ice time of about 15.6 minutes with a shrunk shot rate gives a mean modestly above 1.5. This is a volume case, not one built on an extreme adjustment. The weakness is that a reduced role or a lost power-play shift could pull the mean to the line quickly.","price_case":"This is the main 1.5 line at +110, which needs roughly +110 implied to break even. The model's fair price is near -122 and its minimum is about +106, so the cushion is thin. Two-book consensus sits close to even money. Coverage is thin, and the edge is small relative to model error.","context_case":"Tampa Bay injury listings show day-to-day centers, but a shots prop depends mainly on Jenner's own deployment, which no source addresses. Context is otherwise unverified.","blocking_checks":[]},"countercase":"The margin over the minimum price is narrow, so small model miscalibration or line movement erases it. Shot props hinge on minutes. If Jenner plays a checking role or Washington protects a lead, attempts drop. The market near even money may already reflect his true rate. The bet is correlated with the Dubois points over in the same game.","open_checks":["Confirm Jenner's line and power-play deployment before puck drop.","Reconfirm the +110 price, since a small move would cross the minimum.","Verify BetMGM settlement rules for shots including overtime."],"evidence":[{"source_id":"0630323e33a24c0cf131","excerpt":"Anthony Cirelli (C); Lower Body; Day-to-Day; updated Sun, Nov 15.","interpretation":"If Cirelli misses the game, Tampa Bay's defensive center depth weakens, which could marginally help opposing shot volume. His status is unresolved, and the update is two days old.","kind":"injury","direction":"context","represented_in":"unknown"}]},{"candidate_id":"12848650bf6029509e918594","status":"needs_information","assessment":{"verdict":"consider","reason":"At +150 the break-even is low, the projection is above it, and even the low end of the sensitivity range clears it. Settlement is listed as published rules. No material blocker is identified, though Terry's role and active status are unverified.","model_case":"A mean of about 0.71 points on roughly 17 minutes fits a top-six winger with power-play exposure. The case leans on a shrunk production rate rather than a large adjustment. The weakness is unverified line and power-play assignment.","price_case":"This is the main 0.5 line at +150, with break-even near +150 implied. The model's fair price is near -103 and its minimum is about +117. Two-book consensus is longer than fair but shorter than +150, so this book's quote looks generous. Coverage is still thin.","context_case":"The injury table shows Anaheim forward absences that could affect depth around Terry. No source addresses Terry himself. Hofer is the projected St. Louis starter, not a confirmed one.","blocking_checks":[]},"countercase":"The DraftKings price is longer than consensus, which could reflect stale model inputs or an unseen role change rather than an edge. Anaheim's scoring depth is limited, and a low-event game would sink a single-point over. Variance in points props is large relative to the edge.","open_checks":["Confirm Terry's line and power-play unit at morning skate.","Confirm the St. Louis starting goalie.","Reconfirm that +150 is still available, since it is the outlier quote."],"evidence":[{"source_id":"7a0ab5d95334a3cf2a47","excerpt":"Ryan Poehling (C); Knee; IR. Expected to be out until at least Dec 6","interpretation":"If Poehling stays out, Anaheim's center depth thins. That could modestly raise top-six usage for Terry or reduce the quality of his linemates. The net effect is unclear.","kind":"injury","direction":"context","represented_in":"unknown"}]}]}
